svg.title: Breakwater: the LLM firewall that attacks itself
svg.desc: Animated banner. Messages flow toward a model. Attacks, such as an instruction override, a hidden HTML comment, a tool call to an attacker, and a leaked API key, break against the Breakwater wall; normal questions pass through to the model.

g.text: The LLM firewall that attacks itself.
attack success rate, without → with Breakwater
75 attacks · own red-team harness · simulated model
